features.name: Fisherman retriggers

review:
Big Bass with a reason to watch the base game: fish can get collected at random on any spin, with the prize multiplied by up to 50x.

Three or more scatters give up to 20 free spins, where each fish that lands adds a growing multiplier to its spot – so later fish landing there are worth more. Every four fishermen retrigger. One of the more inventive Big Bass games. 96.07% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
